about: How uw plan groups a stop's places into days and how uw plan and uw validate judge whether a day's places belong together (lib/cmd-plan.mjs). Distances are straight lines in km. grouping: places closer than same_area_km are one area, and a stop's days share an area's places evenly rather than by distance; the trip's first day (an arrival with no travel before it) takes an area too when the full days would otherwise hold more than first_day_over places each (1: every day of the stay gets a place before any gets a second), and no day takes a third place while another of the stop's days has one: that day takes the nearest place of a day with three or more, unless the day-places check below would send it back. The day a later stop is reached is one of its days too after a ride of at most arrival_ride_max_min minutes (the leg's own time, else the estimate from its length): it takes places once the stop has two with their own page for each of its days, that day counted, as days of two near each other that the day-places check below passes where the full days alone pass. day_places: a place is fine near its day's other places (near_km); it is flagged when another day has a place closer_ratio times nearer (it belongs to that day's area), or, failing that, when it is farther than far_km from every other place of its day (the day zigzags). A place farther than trip_out_km from the day's base is a trip out of town (a day trip) and is judged on its own; two stays in a row closer than trip_out_km are places in one city, and uw plan refuses them (one stop, its days by area), unless both are places of their own (a town, a station, an airport, by their kind), or one is and the map's expect names both as stops.
